high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the verified account "tchalamet." The post shows a person standing outdoors on a concrete surface, facing away from the camera. The individual is wearing a black hoodie with white circular details on the sleeves, black pants, and white sneakers. They are holding onto a metal pole with one hand. The setting appears to be an industrial or commercial area, as indicated by the large buildings with modern architecture in the background.
